title: Drive to Great! BAIC FOTON Africa Partners Conference Set to Open
summary_text: BAIC FOTON, a Chinese commercial vehicle manufacturer, is hosting an Africa Partners Conference on October 29 in Port Elizabeth, South Africa, with over 600 distributors and industry partners from 42 African countries. This reflects industrials sector expansion and market development activity.
